name: Probe: can a gameplay script create a typed (Military) alliance? SetHasAllied with a 3rd argument (Alliances index / hash) on DATE-SHIMAZU and NAGAO-MORI, read type/level in the UI context at start and after 1 turn; also DealManager/DiplomacyManager in gameplay and whether the alliance DiplomaticActions survive the Sengoku civic deletion

steps.code: local function q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; local mil=GameInfo.Alliances['ALLIANCE_MILITARY']; local out={'ctx=GameCore_Tuner turn='..q(function() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end), 'DealManager='..q(function() return type(DealManager) end), 'DiplomacyManager='..q(function() return type(DiplomacyManager) end), 'alliance0='..q(function() return GameInfo.Alliances[0].AllianceType end), 'militaryIndex='..q(function() return mil.Index end), 'actionAlliance='..q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticActions['DIPLOACTION_ALLIANCE']~=nil end), 'actionMilitary='..q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticActions['DIPLOACTION_ALLIANCE_MILITARY']~=nil end)}; table.insert(out,'DATE>SHIMAZU setIndex='..q(function() Players[id.DATE]:GetDiplomacy():SetHasAllied(id.SHIMAZU, true, mil.Index); return Players[id.DATE]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(id.SHIMAZU) end)); table.insert(out,'NAGAO>MORI setHash='..q(function() Players[id.NAGAO]:GetDiplomacy():SetHasAllied(id.MORI, true, DB.MakeHash('ALLIANCE_MILITARY')); return Players[id.NAGAO]:GetDiplomacy():HasAllied(id.MORI) end)); for _,f in ipairs({'DATE','SHIMAZU','NAGAO','MORI'}) do pcall(function() Players[id[f]]:GetDiplomacy():RecheckVisibilityOnAll() end) end; local s=table.concat(out,' | '); print('[JAC_ALLIANCE_TYPE_PROBE] '..s); return s

local function q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; local out={'ctx=InGame turn='..q(function() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end)}; for _,d in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'DATE','SHIMAZU'},{'SHIMAZU','DATE'},{'NAGAO','MORI'},{'MORI','NAGAO'}}) do local a,b=id[d[1]],id[d[2]]; if a==nil or b==nil then table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' missing player') else local dip=Players[a]:GetDiplomacy(); table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' state='..q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[a]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(b)].StateType end)..' allianceType='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceType(b) end)..' allianceTypeName='..q(function() local t=dip:GetAllianceType(b); return t==-1 and 'NONE' or GameInfo.Alliances[t].AllianceType end)..' allianceLevel='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceLevel(b) end)..' turnsLeft='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceTurnsUntilExpiration(b) end)..' capVisible='..q(function() local c=Players[b]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); return PlayersVisibility[a]:IsVisible(c:GetX(),c:GetY()) end)) end end; local s=table.concat(out,' | '); print('[JAC_ALLIANCE_TYPE_PROBE] '..s); return s

local function q(f) local ok,v=pcall(f); if ok then return tostring(v) end return 'ERR('..tostring(v)..')' end; local id={}; for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do local f=string.match(PlayerConfigurations[p:GetID()]:GetCivilizationTypeName() or '','^CIVILIZATION_JAC_(.+)$'); if f then id[f]=p:GetID() end end; local out={'ctx=InGame turn='..q(function() return Game.GetCurrentGameTurn() end)}; for _,d in ipairs({{'HOJO','IMAGAWA'},{'DATE','SHIMAZU'},{'SHIMAZU','DATE'},{'NAGAO','MORI'},{'MORI','NAGAO'}}) do local a,b=id[d[1]],id[d[2]]; if a==nil or b==nil then table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' missing player') else local dip=Players[a]:GetDiplomacy(); table.insert(out,d[1]..'>'..d[2]..' state='..q(function() return GameInfo.DiplomaticStates[Players[a]:GetDiplomaticAI():GetDiplomaticStateIndex(b)].StateType end)..' allianceType='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceType(b) end)..' allianceTypeName='..q(function() local t=dip:GetAllianceType(b); return t==-1 and 'NONE' or GameInfo.Alliances[t].AllianceType end)..' allianceLevel='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceLevel(b) end)..' turnsLeft='..q(function() return dip:GetAllianceTurnsUntilExpiration(b) end)..' capVisible='..q(function() local c=Players[b]:GetCities():GetCapitalCity(); return PlayersVisibility[a]:IsVisible(c:GetX(),c:GetY()) end)) end end; local s=table.concat(out,' | '); print('[JAC_ALLIANCE_TYPE_PROBE] '..s); return s
